paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Informativeness and missing step values of 4 representative LLMs
model_annotation: The graph illustrates the relationship between the number of missing steps and the performance of two methods—0-CoT and CoRe—across four different models, as measured by their informativeness. The x-axis represents the model index, ranging from 0 to 4, while the y-axis indicates the missing step value, which decreases from approximately 0.850 to 0.835. The 0-CoT method is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, showing a steady decline in missing steps from around 0.850 at index 0 to about 0.834 at index 4. The CoRe method is depicted by an orange solid line with triangular markers, also decreasing from approximately 0.850 at index 0 to around 0.839 at index 4. Both lines show a consistent downward trend, indicating improved performance as the model index increases, with CoRe consistently having slightly higher missing step values than 0-CoT across all indices.
